data.text: npm's package page warns 'It is taking too long to fetch the source commit' on 0.5.0. Checked: the repository is public, 088d3a7 is reachable through the GitHub API, and the SLSA attestation resolves to git+https://github.com/bogutskiandriy/kadence@refs/heads/main 088d3a7. Nothing is wrong with the package — the warning is npmjs.com timing out on its own lookup of the commit. It appears because 0.5.0 was published by workflow_dispatch on main rather than by a tag push; nothing to fix here.
